_comment: Literature in Zambian Languages -- Secondary Teachers' Diploma syllabus.
First typeset 2026-10-13.
SOURCE. Received as a Word 97 .doc; converted to .docx with Word (Save As) before typesetting.
SUBJECT. Set here: the file name misspells it ("LANGUGAES").
LEVEL / YEAR. As the cover says; 2026 as on the cover and copyright line.
TWO SYLLABUSES IN ONE FILE. After this syllabus's References the manuscript carries a second, complete one: Literature in
Zambian Languages TEACHING METHODS (course name, competences, content, scope, methods, assessment, references). Set as its
own book, as the family sets every Content / Methods pair; it is cut from here (removeRange, to the end). The Preface and
Acknowledgements, written for both "syllabi", print in both books. The Methods book is built from a copy of this .docx:
"LITERATURE IN ZAMBIAN LANGUAGES TEACHING METHODS SYLLABUS TED VALIDATED - Mukanu Kapalang'oma".
SECTION HEADS. The manuscript numbers its sections 1-8 but styles them three ways (heading, bold line, plain); 5. Scope and
Sequence and 6. Teaching and Learning Methods set as loose bold lines. All eight are the same sub-section head (setHeading).
The reading lists under 8. References (Prescribed / Recommended Readings) are labels under it, not pages of their own.
ROUND 1 (Google Drive comments, 25 Oct - 16 Nov 2026, Mushinga K. Mooto): 18 comments, applied 2026-11-17. Each change carries its
comment in _why. The reviewer marked the copy of 13 Oct; the Director's name (Petronella M. Samutete (Ms)) is already the engine's.
The reviewed copy itself (Downloads, 17 Nov) carries the highlights: every comment checked against it. The two novel
activities open 2.2.1.1's list (highlight on its first bullet); the bracket follows 'Analysing a given novel'; both Teaching
Experience items deleted, so the Scope and Sequence row goes. 2.3.3.4 Adjudicate drama came without an expected standard: 'Drama adjudicated appropriately' added,
in the pattern of the three above it -- author to confirm.
NUMBERING CHECK: 3 notes, all on the TEACHING PRACTICE row the reviewer asked for above 2.3 (unnumbered by design).
